definitions.explanation: Having strong self-respect and pride in one's position, tradition, or principles, and refusing to lower oneself.

examples.japanese: {誇|ほこ}り{高|たか}い⟦{民族|みんぞく}→民族：13229_minzoku⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{誇|ほこ}り{高|たか}い⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧だ。
{誇|ほこ}り{高|たか}い⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{助|たす}け→助け：07777_tasuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めよう→求める：02316_motomeru⟧としなかった。
examples.english: Too proud to ask, she never sought help from anyone.

notes:
Built from ⟦{誇|ほこ}り→誇り：03623_hokori⟧ (pride) and ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (high). It is mainly positive (dignified, principled), unlike the plain "proud" of boasting.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦プライド→プライド：22290_puraido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: proud; often negative (touchy, easily offended)
- ⟦{高慢|こうまん}→高慢：19519_kouman⟧: arrogant, haughty; always negative

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{誇|ほこ}り→誇り：03623_hokori⟧ (pride) and ⟦{埃|ほこり}→埃：03624_hokori⟧ (dust) share the reading ほこり.
